provenance: Original synthetic QA scenarios, separately curated from skills/*/examples; expectations specified from scenario rationale before running helpers. AI-authored; no independent human assessor review is claimed.

cases.rationale: Unlinked anchor triggers the known static empty-name heuristic; one image omits alt.
known_false_positives: CONTROL_NAME on an anchor without href: it is a destination, not an interactive link.
known_false_negatives: Unhelpful alt='image' is present, so purpose and quality are missed. Browser behavior is untested.

cases.rationale: One missing version, one missing license assertion, one duplicate ref, one unknown dependency.
known_false_positives: Missing version/license is a local inventory-quality gap, not necessarily a schema violation.
known_false_negatives: No official schema, vulnerability, license-expression, provenance or completeness validation.

cases.rationale: NOASSERTION is deliberately valid evidence uncertainty, reported as a local quality gap.
known_false_positives: NOASSERTION is allowed in SPDX; this finding must not be called a format failure.
known_false_negatives: Download location, rights, relationships and package completeness require separate review.

cases.rationale: Anonymous alternative on a public operation, identifier path test need, and an unresolved local traversal-shaped ref.
known_false_positives: Public access is intentional in this case; object-ID presence is not proof of a vulnerability.
known_false_negatives: Declared bearer authentication says nothing about enforcement, limits, or tenant isolation.

cases.rationale: Closed low-priority risk lacks evidence; accepted high-priority risk has only a supplied evidence assertion.
known_false_positives: Missing evidence may mean a recordkeeping gap, not absence of an actual approval.
known_false_negatives: Supplied approval evidence is not checked for authority, currency or effectiveness; severe harm may outrank numeric triage.

cases.rationale: Comment is data; offline parsing must not execute it. Host instruction resistance is a separate manual test.
known_false_negatives: A passing offline parser test does not establish agent-host prompt-injection resistance.
